title: Tracking and Limiting Unsupported Claim Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Provenance-Aware Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.26957v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This research examines how unsupported claims change as they move through multi-agent pipelines. It also examines whether preserving provenance can reduce these changes. We test both homogeneous and heterogeneous pipelines. Homogeneous pipelines use the same model across agents, while heterogeneous pipelines use different models. We compare the baseline with a provenance-aware framework. The framework passes each claim with its support status, source, evidence and transmission history. No new evidence is introduced during transmission. We measure changes in claim meaning, unsupported detail accretion, semantic drift, and provenance preservation. These metrics show whether the framework limits unsupported changes as claims pass between agents.

translated_title: 多智能体大语言模型系统中无依据论断传播的追踪与限制：一种溯源感知框架
translated_abstract: 本研究考察了无依据论断在多智能体流水线中传递时如何发生变化，并探讨了保留溯源信息能否减少这些变化。我们测试了同质与异质两种流水线：同质流水线中各智能体使用相同的模型，而异质流水线中各智能体使用不同的模型。我们将基线方法与一个溯源感知框架进行对比，该框架在传递每条论断时同时附带其支持状态、来源、证据及传输历史，且在传输过程中不引入任何新证据。我们测量了论断含义的变化、无依据细节的累积、语义漂移以及溯源信息的保留程度。这些指标可以表明该框架能否在论断于智能体之间传递时限制无依据的变化。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个溯源感知框架，通过在多智能体LLM流水线中随论断一同传递其支持状态、来源、证据与传输历史，有效追踪并限制了无依据论断在智能体间传播时的语义漂移与无依据细节累积。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a provenance-aware framework that tracks and limits the propagation of unsupported claims in multi-agent LLM pipelines by transmitting each claim along with its support status, source, evidence, and transmission history.
